culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yutaka Abe. Yutaka's reason to kill his best friend is that he is on the verge of bankruptcy and he tricked the much richer Negishi to fall on his plan. He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him. He betrayed Negishi, then commited the murder because he wanted to take the insurance.

motive.quote: He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him.

motive.zhHans: 他与喝醉的 Negishi 打赌：只要他能成功藏匿起来，Abe 就把自己的人寿保险金给他。他背弃了这个约定，随后为了把那笔保险金据为己有而杀人。第二天，Yutaka 让小五郎跟踪一个长相酷似 Negishi 的替身，好让小五郎以为 Negishi 一直到周三夜里都还活着。Yutaka 的计划是带着 Negishi 的钱逃往国外，去西雅图。
motive.en: He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him. He betrayed Negishi, then commited the murder because he wanted to take the insurance. The next day, Yutaka had Kogoro follow a fake who looked like Negishi in order to make him think Negishi was alive through Wednesday night. Yutaka's plan is to escape the country, going to Seattle, taking Negishi's money with him.

method.zhHans: Yutaka 杀害挚友的原因是濒临破产，于是他设计让远比他有钱的 Negishi 落入自己的圈套。第二天，他让小五郎跟踪一个长相酷似 Negishi 的替身，好让小五郎以为 Negishi 一直到周三夜里都还活着。接着，Yutaka 在周五夜里结束旅行归来，装作若无其事，并拿出了完整的不在场证明。小五郎意识到自己被欺骗后怒不可遏，但他只能证明 Yutaka 骗他去跟踪了一个替身，并不能证明 Yutaka 就是凶手。所幸柯南在 Yutaka 登机外逃之前当面揭穿了他，设法诱使他亲口承认罪行并录了下来。
method.en: Yutaka's reason to kill his best friend is that he is on the verge of bankruptcy and he tricked the much richer Negishi to fall on his plan. The next day, Yutaka had Kogoro follow a fake who looked like Negishi in order to make him think Negishi was alive through Wednesday night. Then, Yutaka came back from his trip on Friday night acting innocent with his complete alibi. Kogoro is completely infuriated when he realizes that he had been lied to, but he can only prove that Yutaka tricked him into following a double, NOT that he is the criminal. Fortunately, Conan confronts him for the murder before he escapes on an airplane and Conan manages to trick him and record him admitting the crime.

evidence.zhHans: 这就是证据，说明小五郎跟踪的人并非 Negishi，而是另一个人。Negishi 的尸体是在周四傍晚、也就是著名的火祭期间被发现的。小五郎意识到自己被欺骗后怒不可遏，但他只能证明 Yutaka 骗他去跟踪了一个替身，并不能证明 Yutaka 就是凶手。柯南还把录音磁带留在 Yutaka 身边，这样警方找到他时，就能凭充分的证据将他逮捕。
evidence.en: This is the proof that the person Kogoro stalked is not Negishi but a different person. Negishi's body was found on Thursday evening, during the famous fire festival. Kogoro is completely infuriated when he realizes that he had been lied to, but he can only prove that Yutaka tricked him into following a double, NOT that he is the criminal. Conan also leaves the casette tape beside Yutaka so when the police find him, he will be arrested with sufficient evidence.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yutaka Abe。他杀害挚友的原因是濒临破产，于是他设计让远比他有钱的 Negishi 落入自己的圈套。他与喝醉的 Negishi 打赌：只要他能成功藏匿起来，Abe 就把自己的人寿保险金给他。他背弃了这个约定，随后为了把那笔保险金据为己有而杀人。Negishi 实际上是在周二夜里、也就是 Yutaka 出发去九州旅行前的那晚死亡的。第二天，Yutaka 让小五郎跟踪一个长相酷似 Negishi 的替身，好让小五郎以为 Negishi 一直到周三夜里都还活着。Negishi 是右撇子，而照片上的男人却是左撇子。这就是证据，说明小五郎跟踪的人并非 Negishi，而是另一个人。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yutaka Abe. Yutaka's reason to kill his best friend is that he is on the verge of bankruptcy and he tricked the much richer Negishi to fall on his plan. He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him. He betrayed Negishi, then commited the murder because he wanted to take the insurance. Negishi really died on Tuesday night, the night before Yutaka left on his vacation in Kyushu. The next day, Yutaka had Kogoro follow a fake who looked like Negishi in order to make him think Negishi was alive through Wednesday night. Negishi is right-handed but the man on the photos is left-handed. This is the proof that the person Kogoro stalked is not Negishi but a different person.

summary.en: As Conan is waking form Agasa house he sees Kogoro following someone. When he asks, Kogoro sends Conan home for dinner. A few days later at the Akaoni Village Fire Festival a burnt body is found in the fire.
